subject: 9 CySA analyst modules are now in no curated sequence
description:
Retiring the cysa-plus path (operator ruling, BUG-038) leaves these 9 reachable only via ContentCatalog house browsing, which the strict-orphan-scanner deliberately does not count as curation: shield-cve-lookup, shield-cysa-toolkit, cyberops-attack-surface-vuln, cyberops-cvss-terminology, cyberops-evidence-types, cyberops-irp-elements, cyberops-nist-800-86, cyberops-risk-rating, cyberops-soc-metrics. This is a TRUE finding, not a scanner artifact -- the honest cost of retiring the aggregate. Options if it matters later: fold them into the security-operations path, add them to the canonical CySA+ course page, or leave them as browsable house content. Content is live and unaffected either way.
[2026-07-29 03:28] CORRECTED 2026-07-28 (Nancy, reconciled with data): the claim that all 9 are uncurated is WRONG. Seven of them ARE linked from hand-authored CyberOps weekly curriculum pages -- cyberops-cvss-terminology and cyberops-risk-rating from week1/index.html, attack-surface-vuln from week2, evidence-types from week3, irp-elements + nist-800-86 + soc-metrics from week5. Those pages are real curriculum, structurally identical to the eye/cysa case that motivated #238; the scanner just cannot see them for the same reason. ONLY shield-cve-lookup and shield-cysa-toolkit are genuinely uncurated (no index.html links either). So the honest cost of retiring cysa-plus is 2 modules, not 9. This entry stays open for those 2; the other 7 resolve when #238 ships.
[2026-07-31 11:08] VERIFIED 2026-07-31 against a FRESHLY REGENERATED scan (not the stale 07-29 report). Nancy's 2026-07-28 correction holds exactly: the 7 cyberops modules ARE rescued -- cyberops-risk-rating and siblings no longer appear anywhere in the orphan report, picked up by mechanism5_coursePageLinks (2423 rescues) now that #238 has shipped. The 2 shield modules remain genuinely uncurated: shield-cysa-toolkit is listed in the shield house's 'CompTIA CySA+ (CS0-003)' orphan cluster (count=1), and shield-cve-lookup also still appears. Independently confirmed by hand: neither id nor its file (shield-cve-lookup.tool.html / shield-cysa-analyst-toolkit.applet.html) is referenced by ANY index.html, Data.js or LearningPaths -- the only references are their own files and the content registry. So the remaining scope of this ticket is exactly 2 modules, as documented. METHOD WARNING for whoever picks this up: STRICT_ORPHAN_MAP.json contains ONLY summary + byHouse (per-cluster SAMPLES), with no full orphan array. A script doing d.get('orphans') gets an empty list and will silently conclude everything is resolved -- I made exactly that mistake before checking the file's actual shape.
[2026-07-31 19:03] SCOPE WAS 1, NOT 2. shield-cve-lookup was already curated by the incubator hub card (4a94862e4); the 11:08 note was written against an 11:07:07Z scan while that commit landed 11:25:19Z. Fresh scan clears it with no code change and drops platform orphans 544->439. shield-cysa-toolkit curated into the security-operations path (registry already declared that placement). Both now CURATED; render-verified on the course page, link 200. Awaiting Nancy.
[2026-07-31 19:11] CORRECTION to my earlier note, per Nancy. I wrote that 'the stale report was overstating orphans by 105' and attributed the 544->438 drop to the 18-minute scan gap. That causal claim is NOT supported. The regenerated scan is ~8 hours and 34 commits after the stale one, and the mechanism deltas are +107 hubCard / +217 coursePageLinks -- far too large to be one module arriving late. Most of it is unrelated same-day work (4a94862e4 alone touched 13 files, +1690 lines, taking shield 111->173 cards). WHAT IS ACTUALLY VERIFIED: both target ids are resolved, confirmed by direct id lookup in the before/after JSON, and shield-cve-lookup's curation predates today's ticket work via the incubator card. WHAT IS NOT: any claim that scan staleness alone accounts for the 105. RESOLUTION CHANGED TOO: shield-cysa-toolkit is now curated via the shield incubator (7fd6a2dd3), not the security-operations path array -- Nancy found that appending to path.modules silently lowers every current student's completion percentage, since getPathOverview divides by modules.length and prerequisites:[] does not affect it. LearningPaths.js reverted byte-identical. Nancy's Q2 (why security-plus was left un-reconciled) is moot: I no longer touch either path array.
[2026-07-31 20:03] SCOPE IS ZERO, NOT 1 (and not the 2 the ticket opened with). Chris BLOCK: shield-cysa-toolkit is in _app/data/security-plus-manifest.json:679 with a real curriculum position (SY0-701 Domain 4.0 Security Operations, module 'Vulnerability & Threat Management', mseq 2), fetched at runtime by houses/shield/security-plus/index.html which is linked from lobby.html. Confirmed live in production by curl. My reachability check searched index.html/Data.js/LearningPaths and never looked at _app/data/*.json -- the same blind spot as #238, which I closed two hours earlier for the identical category of miss. Incubator card REVERTED byte-identical (1a1fb33c2); net content change of this ticket is zero. THE REAL REMAINING WORK IS A SCANNER FIX, not content: strict-orphan-scanner resolves literal HTML href/data-module (mech1) and same-house course-page hrefs (mech5) but NOT JSON-manifest-driven pages, so it will keep reporting manifest-curated modules as orphans platform-wide. Needs a mechanism6 that resolves ids/hrefs out of _app/data/*.json. Until that exists, treat any orphan-report entry as UNVERIFIED until you grep _app/data/*.json by hand.
